messages:
alex (docs): Hey team — opened a PR to add Lumen5B to the model catalog + quickstart snippets. Need: final perf numbers, compatibility note for the q4 quant variant, and a small migration note for SDK v3 streaming changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421 :wave:

maria (ml): I ran the microbench earlier. Numbers below (p50 token latency, single-stream, fp16): Lumen5B: 12ms/token at 512 seq on A100; Lumen5B-q4 (quantized): 9ms/token but degrades after 2048 due to KV cache memory layout. Throughput (batch=8): 140 tok/s fp16, 180 tok/s q4.

sam (runtime): Note on runtime side: q4 currently uses the fallback CPU-kernel for block attention >2048 which explains the degrade. We can add a compatibility note: "q4 supports up to 2048 sequence comfortably; for 2048-4096 expect degraded latency and increased memory. For >4096, use fp16 variant."

kofi (sdk): Quick SDK snippet fixes — the PR has old SDK v2 examples. We should show both generate and streaming for SDK v3. Proposed Python streaming snippet to paste:

```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
with client.generate_stream(model="lumen5b") as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

And short JS example for embeddings (new client.imports):

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'lumen5b-embed', input: 'hello' })
console.log(emb.data[0].embedding.length)
```

alex (docs): perfect, kofi — can you paste the exact import path and function names (I copied guesswork)? I want code to be runnable. Also we need a one-line product-friendly blurb for the card.

jen (product): suggested blurb: "Lumen5B — compact, low-latency 5B encoder-decoder optimized for chat and instruction tasks. Offers a q4 quantized build for lower-cost inference with tradeoffs on long contexts." Keep it short. :+1:

maria (ml): compatibility callouts to add to card: "Quantized variant (q4) uses int8 kernels and is validated up to 2048 tokens. For workloads with frequent prefix caching or very long contexts prefer fp16. Quality regression on instruction-following is minimal for prompts under 1024 tokens; evaluate your instruction set before switching."

sam (runtime): Also add an ops note: "If you use Dedicated or Private with multi-GPU routing, pin fp16 for >2048 SLOs; otherwise runtime will auto-fallback and you may see higher tail latency."

alex (docs): small checklist for PR reviewers in the thread: - update model card front-matter (model family, arch, tokenizer) - add limits table (seq limits for fp16/q4) - include bench numbers and test harness link - replace SDK v2 snippets with v3 examples - verify model weights link (it was 404 in initial PR) - product blurb + security/data note

kofi (sdk): import path is `from @redwood/inference` in JS (default export), and Python is `from redwood import Redwood`. The streaming API name is `generate_stream` in the current studio branch — I pasted the correct call. I'll push a tiny PR to docs repo to update snippets after this thread.

alex (docs): the weights link got flagged by docs-bot as broken in the PR checks — current url is https://models.redwood.ai/lumen5b/v1/weights.tar.gz which 404s. Maria, can you confirm canonical weights URL or we should link to model registry instead?

maria (ml): canonical registry entry is https://models.redwood.ai/registry/lumen5b — prefer linking registry. I'll follow up with infra to push the weight tar to the public bucket, ETA 24h.

docs-bot: PR check failed — broken links found: /lumen5b/v1/weights.tar.gz. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654 for logs.

alex (docs): OK I'll update PR to point at registry URL and include a short "will add direct weights link when available" note. Anyone object to me adding a short migration note under the SDK section: "If migrating from SDK v2, replace client.generate(stream...) with client.generate_stream(...) and update import path"?

jen (product): go ahead. Also add a callout for Dedicated tier: "Dedicated customers: contact support to enable q4 kernels on your pool if you want consistent q4 latency for long contexts."

sam (runtime): One more tiny suggestion — add an example `limits` JSON snippet in the card so infra teams can parse it automatically. e.g.:

```
"limits": { "fp16_max_seq": "8192", "q4_max_seq": "2048" }
```

alex (docs): love that. I'll add a minimal JSON snippet and call out that these are tested-safe defaults.

kofi (sdk): pushing small snippet PR now. ETA ~30m.

maria (ml): tagging the eval harness here: https://bench.redwood.ai/runs/lumen5b/2026-03-20 — includes reproducible perf scripts. Add as bench link on card.

alex (docs): thanks everyone — I'll update the PR with these changes, remove the old SDK v2 code, fix the link to registry, add bench link and migration note. Ping me for a last pass. :eyes: 

jen (product): :thumbsup: ship it when green.

kofi (sdk): done — PR for snippets at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7423

alex (docs): Updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421 — changes: replaced code snippets, added limits JSON, product blurb, bench link, compatibility note. Waiting on infra for weight link.

maria (ml): infra confirmed weights push in progress. Will update thread when done.

alex (docs): marking this thread resolved for docs edits. Will re-open if infra link doesn't land by EOD. Thanks all. :party:
